verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an agent-integration platform with SDKs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out in the SDKs, CLI or platform. The only related material describes activity logs, traces and session inspection, which are observability features rather than tracking controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
